classification: Author qualitative review of frozen advisory outputs; not blinded, not an independent native legality oracle or a win-rate estimate

rubric.mechanical_correctness: Check explicit causal/eligibility claims against source doctrine and scenario evidence; a valid candidate ID is not proof of native legality.
rubric.strategic_coherence: Allow different capable choices; look for objective, bottleneck, cost, timing and occupation reasoning.
rubric.epistemic_discipline: Flag facts invented from priors, stale evidence or absent costs; requested investigation cannot retroactively justify an asserted fact.
rubric.investigation: Judge redundant versus material questions; count requested investigations only, no actual tool-call or tool-latency measurement.
rubric.fairness: Private state is absent from this corpus. Actual hidden/controller exclusion is tested by adapter and native/provider boundary tests.
rubric.limitations: One model, fixed seed, temperature zero, thinking disabled, one response per arm/case; no longitudinal strategy or native action execution.
